brief: Indian shares are trying to steady after a sharp global sell-off, with US futures jumping and gold rebounding over 2%, though the Sensex and Nifty are still lower and investors have lost Rs 4.65 lakh crore. The APL Apollo and Tata Steel deal is the main stock story, and the postponed Tata Sons board meeting adds uncertainty.
themes: APL Apollo and Tata Steel deal fallout
Global sell-off versus US futures rebound
